name: Kami-e
description: One of the Six Powers (Rokushiki): bending with blows, then slipping through crowds, then a body that flows past anything.

stages.name: Bending with blows
stages.text: You managed Kami-e for the first time: bending with blows.

stages.name: Slipping through crowds
stages.text: Kami-e came to you without thinking now: slipping through crowds.

stages.name: A body that flows past anything
stages.description: Kami-e mastered: a body that flows past anything.
stages.text: You had mastered Kami-e: a body that flows past anything.
